title: A Fourier-analytic Uniqueness Theorem for Lattice-point Enumerators
summary: We consider a bounded set $P \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ and the lattice-point enumerator $L_P(t) = |tP \cap \mathbb{Z}^d|$ for real $t > 0$. We show that if two bounded measurable sets with boundary of measure zero have the same real-parameter lattice-point enumerators for all integer translates, then their indicator functions agree almost everywhere. As a corollary, any convex body is uniquely determined by this data.
